correctness.rationale: The exact 2x2 Gaussian antiderivatives give a simple central top eigenvalue and an analytically reconstructed strictly positive universal second derivative. A uniformly differentiable spectral perturbation expansion around two strict maxima of the limiting Gaussian-Hermite diagonal reproduces the quartic optimizer displacement and the leading, cubic and quintic optimal concentration coefficients. Gaussian tail control and strict concavity establish exactly two small-width maxima; no global uniqueness for arbitrary width is assumed. Independent high-precision quadrature-based code executed 100 numerical assertions, without conflating checks with the proof.

value.rationale: Rank-two Hermite concentration is the first coherent Hermite band where symmetric window placement loses optimality. The result rules out central optimization for all finite intervals, quantifies a sharp 2/sqrt(e) short-window gain, and identifies the unexpectedly vanished quadratic location correction and explicit quartic displacement. These are natural stability and localization invariants for finite-mode Gaussian time-frequency windows, not an arbitrary numerical example.
